mapper.sql: SELECT portal_user.portal_user_id FROM sys_portal_user portal_user JOIN crm_contact contact ON contact.tenant_id = portal_user.tenant_id AND contact.contact_id = portal_user.ref_biz_id AND contact.customer_id = portal_user.customer_id JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.tenant_id = contact.tenant_id AND customer.customer_id = contact.customer_id JOIN sys_tenant tenant ON tenant.tenant_id = portal_user.tenant_id WHERE portal_user.tenant_id = #{identity.tenantId} AND portal_user.portal_user_id = #{identity.portalUserId} AND portal_user.customer_id = #{identity.customerId} AND portal_user.ref_biz_id = #{identity.contactId} AND portal_user.user_type = 'CUSTOMER_CONTACT' AND portal_user.ref_biz_type = 'CRM_CONTACT' AND portal_user.status = 'ACTIVE' AND portal_user.deleted = 0 AND portal_user.session_version = #{identity.sessionVersion} AND contact.version = #{identity.contactVersion} AND contact.status = 'ACTIVE' AND contact.deleted = 0 AND customer.status = 'ACTIVE' AND customer.deleted = 0 AND tenant.status = '0' AND tenant.deleted = 0 AND (tenant.expire_time IS NULL OR tenant.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{identity.tenantId} AND customer_id = #{identity.customerId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.sql: ticket.ticket_id, ticket.ticket_no, ticket.ticket_title AS title, CASE WHEN ticket.portal_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND ticket.owner_id IS NULL AND ticket.status = 'OPEN' THEN 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' ELSE ticket.status END AS status, ticket.sla_status, ticket.opened_time, ticket.first_response_due, ticket.first_response_time, ticket.resolution_due, ticket.resolved_time, ticket.response_breached_flag AS response_breached, ticket.resolution_breached_flag AS resolution_breached
mapper.select:
SELECT
AND ticket.ticket_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ticket.portal_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND ticket.owner_id IS NULL AND ticket.status = 'OPEN'
AND ticket.status = #{status} AND (ticket.portal_contact_id IS NULL OR ticket.owner_id IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY ticket.opened_time DESC, ticket.ticket_id DESC

SELECT , CASE WHEN ticket.portal_contact_id IS NOT NULL THEN ticket.description ELSE NULL END AS description, CASE WHEN ticket.portal_solution_time IS NOT NULL THEN ticket.portal_solution ELSE NULL END AS solution, CASE WHEN ticket.portal_solution IS NOT NULL THEN ticket.portal_solution_time ELSE NULL END AS solution_published_time AND ticket.ticket_id = #{ticketId}
SELECT ticket_id, tenant_id, customer_id, portal_contact_id, ticket_title, description, deleted FROM crm_service_ticket WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket_no = #{number}

SELECT files.file_id, files.file_name, files.file_size, files.file_type AS extension FROM sys_file files JOIN crm_service_ticket ticket ON ticket.tenant_id = files.tenant_id AND CAST(ticket.ticket_id AS CHAR) = files.biz_id JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.tenant_id = ticket.tenant_id AND customer.customer_id = ticket.customer_id WHERE files.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket.ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND ticket.deleted = 0 AND customer.deleted = 0 AND files.biz_type = 'CRM_PORTAL_TICKET' AND files.portal_owner_id IS NOT NULL AND files.deleted = 0 AND files.access_type = 'PRIVATE' AND files.file_type REGEXP '^[a-z0-9]{1,10}$' ORDER BY files.file_id
SELECT file_id, portal_owner_id, biz_type, access_type, deleted FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: FROM sys_user users LEFT JOIN sys_dept department ON department.tenant_id = users.tenant_id AND department.dept_id = users.dept_id AND department.deleted = 0 AND department.status = '0' WHERE users.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND users.status = '0' AND users.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role membership JOIN sys_role roles ON roles.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND roles.role_id = membership.role_id WHERE membership.tenant_id = users.tenant_id AND membership.user_id = users.user_id AND roles.role_key IN ('admin', 'sales_manager', 'sales_rep', 'customer_success') AND roles.status = '0' AND roles.deleted = 0) AND 3 = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT menu.perms) FROM sys_user_role permission_membership JOIN sys_role permission_role ON permission_role.tenant_id = permission_membership.tenant_id AND permission_role.role_id = permission_membership.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu grants ON grants.tenant_id = permission_role.tenant_id AND grants.role_id = permission_role.role_id JOIN sys_menu menu ON menu.menu_id = grants.menu_id AND menu.status = '0' WHERE permission_membership.tenant_id = users.tenant_id AND permission_membership.user_id = users.user_id AND permission_role.status = '0' AND permission_role.deleted = 0 AND menu.perms IN ('crm:ticket:list', 'crm:ticket:edit', 'crm:ticket:respond'))
mapper.select:
SELECT users.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(users.nick_name, ''), users.user_name) AS name, department.dept_name AS department
AND (users.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR users.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY users.user_id
SELECT users.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(users.nick_name, ''), users.user_name) AS name, department.dept_name AS department AND users.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user users JOIN sys_user_role membership ON membership.tenant_id = users.tenant_id AND membership.user_id = users.user_id JOIN sys_role roles ON roles.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND roles.role_id = membership.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu grants ON grants.tenant_id = roles.tenant_id AND grants.role_id = roles.role_id JOIN sys_menu menu ON menu.menu_id = grants.menu_id AND menu.status = '0' WHERE users.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND users.user_id = #{userId} AND users.deleted = 0 AND users.status = '0' AND roles.role_key IN ('admin', 'customer_success') AND roles.deleted = 0 AND roles.status = '0' AND menu.perms = 'crm:ticket:edit')

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user users JOIN sys_user_role membership ON membership.tenant_id = users.tenant_id AND membership.user_id = users.user_id JOIN sys_role roles ON roles.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND roles.role_id = membership.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu grants ON grants.tenant_id = roles.tenant_id AND grants.role_id = roles.role_id JOIN sys_menu menu ON menu.menu_id = grants.menu_id AND menu.status = '0' WHERE users.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND users.user_id = #{userId} AND users.deleted = 0 AND users.status = '0' AND roles.deleted = 0 AND roles.status = '0' AND menu.perms = 'crm:portal:solution:publish')
